The [[Eyttyrmin Batiiv]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] maintained a '''stronghold''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Courkrus]] in the [[Khuiumin system/Legends|Khuiumin system]] as their main base of operations. During the [[Battle of Khuiumin]], a number of the pirates retreated to the stronghold to prepare for a last-ditch siege against the attacking [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces. A [[Standard day/Legends|day]] after the pirates were crushed in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], the stronghold was demolished by a barrage of [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]] from the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Crusader (Victory-class)|''Crusader'']].<ref name="ATPA">{{WEGCite|story=Against the Pirate Armada|book=The Star Wars Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>
